claim.quote: No signal associated with nuclear recoils from WIMP interactions was observed in any run with any crystal. This allowed us to set upper limits on the WIMP-nucleon spin-independent and WIMP-proton spin-dependent cross-sections.

name: Limits on WIMP cross-sections from the NAIAD experiment at the Boulby Underground Laboratory

summary.plain: NaIAD's final analysis found no sign of dark matter in any of its crystals and set upper limits, including strong limits on spin-dependent interactions.
summary.technical: 44.9 kg yr from 2 encapsulated and 4 unencapsulated NaI(Tl) crystals, pulse shape discrimination; the abstract states 'The NAIAD experiment has so far imposed the most stringent constraints on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross-section.'

title: Limits on WIMP cross-sections from the NAIAD experiment at the Boulby Underground Laboratory
why_it_matters: Final NaIAD results; a NaI target is the same technique as DAMA's, here with pulse-shape discrimination.
